build_partial_lower_subgraphs: build a function that lowers Inductor-compatible portions of an fx.GraphModule to Inductor
create_subgraph_module: create an fx.GraphModule from a list of input, body, and output nodes
lower_subgraph_nodes: lower a list of fx nodes into an Inductor-compiled subgraph module within a parent graph
test_inductor_compatible: test whether an fx graph node is compatible with Inductor lowering
refactor_inductor_module: refactor the _InductorModule class to wrap a subgraph with lazy Inductor compilation
